name: Honey garlic soy stir-fry with cashews
title: Honey garlic stir-fry

steps.text: Make the sauce: garlic, soy, sesame oil, lemon juice, honey, 100ml water, cornflour. Blend.
Chop the veg/meat; grate the ginger; crush the cashews. Kettle on.
Hot water over the noodles for 4 min, then into cold water (keep the hot water).
Hot wok, splash of oil; ginger, then the veg (and meat), keep it moving; add cashews.
Push veg aside, sauce into the empty side until it thickens, stir through.
Noodles in, stir through; splash of noodle water to loosen.
